config.reference_summary:
> Saving consistently and investing in the stock market are two practical ways for anyone to grow their money over time.  
> Spreading investments across many companies — such as through an index fund — reduces the risk of losing money if one company performs poorly.  
> Starting early is the most powerful advantage an investor can have, because time allows compound growth to multiply even small contributions into significant wealth.

Write EXACTLY 3 lines:
Line 1: Save regularly; it is crucial for building wealth.
Line 2: Investing wisely through accounts like savings or bank deposits allows growth.
Line 3: Even small contributions make a significant difference over time.

non_rag.text: Many strategies can be applied to grow one’s net worth. These include consistent saving each month – even a small amount helps over time – strategic investment in a bank account or stock market funds like index funds and diversified portfolio building across various assets. Focusing on time—allowing investments to mature through compounding—is also vital, along with having clear financial goals—such as retirement or homeownership —to enhance decision-making. Crucially, embracing gradual action is key – starting small consistently increases the likelihood of substantial wealth accumulation.
